category: Done-for-you growth system for reptile sellers

positioning.headline: The customer journey engine for reptile breeders.
positioning.subheadline: Reptiscale gives reptile sellers the website, CRM, follow-up, social content, checkout, safe-shipping workflow, care onboarding, reviews, and referrals they wish they had time to build.
positioning.primaryCustomer: Reptile breeders and exotic animal sellers doing $20k-$150k in annual sales who already sell through shows, social media, MorphMarket, and DMs.
positioning.wedge: Start with crested gecko and gecko breeders because the demo is specific, visual, shipping-sensitive, and easy to explain.

packages.name: Starter

Core CRM fields, tags, and smart lists

packages.name: Growth
packages.bestFor: Active sellers who need the full buyer journey, shipping automation, and content engine.

packages.name: Scale
